edges: Bondi Beach hosted the beach volleyball competition at the 2000 Summer Olympics.
Campaigners oppose the social and environmental consequences of the development at Bondi Beach.
Bondi Beach is located in the suburb of Bondi, in the Local Government Area of Waverley, seven kilometers from the center of Sydney.
Bondi Beach has a commercial area along Campbell Parade and adjacent side streets, featuring many popular cafes, restaurants, and hotels.
